enunciado: Starting from n = 27, apply the Collatz rule (if n is even n = n / 2, otherwise n = 3n + 1) while n is not 1. Show the number of steps and the largest value reached.
objetivos: Repeat while a condition is true
Use counters and maximums inside a loop
pistas: You do not know in advance how many iterations there will be: hence while.
Make sure n changes on every iteration so the loop ends.
Update the maximum after computing the new n.
